content.text:
**Finding: Compliant (at fallback) — no redline proposed.**

- **Commitment exists:** § 5a requires Client to pay "not less than $\_\_\_\_ per month" for Hosting and Support Services — so this is not the preferred no-minimum position.
- **But the exit is there:** § 13 sets a 1-year term with 30 days' notice of non-renewal, and § 14 lets Client terminate at will, effective the last day of the month following notice. The commitment therefore never runs beyond the current 12-month term and is exitable on short notice.
- **No penalty mechanic:** no shortfall fee, liquidated damages or take-or-pay clawback; no volume caps on our usage.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the minimum amounts are blank and should be negotiated at or below expected usage; § 6 also carves the minimum monthly fees out of our documentation/dispute rights, which belongs to the invoicing rule rather than this one.
